title: feat(spec): source the react-tier component contract from the spec schemas
body:
Course-correction from the platform-author steer: the standard components are **already defined in the spec** (FormView/ListView in `view.zod`, RecordDetails/Highlights/RelatedList/Path in `component.zod`, Chart in `chart.zod`) — so the AI contract is now **generated from them**, not hand-authored.

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts`** — the component-type → spec-schema **index** (the small 'completion' that lets tooling enumerate which schema defines a block) + a thin **React-interaction overlay** (`binding`/`controlled`/`callback` — objectName, recordId, mode, onSuccess, onRowClick, … — inherently React, absent from the declarative schema). Curated per-block via `dataProps` allowlists (ADR-0080 'capability ≠ contract').
- **`scripts/build-react-blocks-contract.ts`** — generator: `z.toJSONSchema(spec schema)` → `data` props with the spec's own descriptions; merge the overlay; emit the AI reference (`references/react-blocks.md`) + machine contract (`.json`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:react-blocks`.
- Replaces the Phase-1 hand-authored contract — now spec-sourced + drift-free. api-surface snapshot updated (+4 additive, 0 breaking); spec 6650 tests green.

The result: `<ObjectForm>`/`<ListView>`/`<RecordDetails>`/… each list their props with the **spec's authoritative descriptions** for config props + the React overlay for interaction. Follow-up: `os build` prop-validation gate consuming this contract.
